name: Do I need a permit for entry door replacement in Orange County?
description: Replacing an entry door of the same size usually doesn't require a permit in Orange County. Structural changes may require one.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for entry door replacement in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, replacing an existing entry door with a new one of the same size does not require a building permit in most Orange County cities, including Irvine or Orange. However, if the installation involves structural changes, such as widening the opening or adding new framing, a permit may be necessary. We can help determine if your specific project requires a permit and guide you through the process.
